rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)

problems.what: the first 1.5 s is only a hand swooping in and a small sun; no words until the title at about 3.3 s, so the piece does not say what it is
problems.fix: write the question 'How does a rainbow form?' first, big and fast (done by about 0.8 s), then draw the scene under it

problems.what: while captions 1-4 are written in the top third, the 25° arm and sleeve run down across the whole raindrop, hiding the rays being explained; the same in the recap, where the arm covers the right-hand icons while the headline is written
problems.fix: turn the arm toward the right edge (nearly horizontal) when the pen is in the upper part of the vertical frame, so it covers only empty board beside the caption

problems.what: the erase-wipes glide and then fade: the eraser decelerates to a stop (ease-in-out) and nothing lands on the beat; only a rising whoosh marks them, so the three biggest changes in the piece have no punch
problems.fix: sweep on an accelerating curve that lands on the beat, with a camera kick, a puff of eraser dust and a hit at the landing

problems.what: 'Red outside, violet inside.' (the key caption of the big picture) finishes about 1.3 s before the eraser starts; the final recap hold is only about 25 frames
problems.fix: tighten the step boards (they idle 1-1.5 s each), start the big picture a beat earlier and give the recap more room, so the caption holds over 2 s and the end holds about 1 s

problems.what: the hand parks in the corner while the board waits for a fixed caption frame: dead waiting, part of the 34 s without a single abrupt change
problems.fix: write each caption straight after its drawing and move the idle time to the end of the piece

problems.what: the 24 px mono 'colour spread exaggerated' note and the 28-30 px 'violet about 40°' / 'white light' labels are the weakest text at phone size; the 26 px mono footer too
problems.fix: 30 px for the mono note and footer, 34-36 px for the small labels

agentSaw: hook 7: the first 1.5 s is only the hand swooping in and drawing the sun; the title is written at about 3.5 s
variety 7: 0 changes per 10 s and one 34 s calm, because the piece is one continuous board
in the vertical the arm and sleeve cover much of the drop while captions 3-4 are written
'Red outside, violet inside.' is readable only about 1.3 s before the wipe
the recap leaves only about 25 frames of final hold
the 24 px mono 'colour spread exaggerated' note is the weakest text
the colour spread inside the drop is exaggerated (labelled), with true exit angles
agentMissed: the erase-wipes have no landing: they decelerate to a stop and only a rising whoosh marks them
the vertical arm also covers captions 1-2's drop and the recap icons, not only during captions 3-4
the hand idles in the corner for 1-2 s in each step waiting for fixed caption frames
the 'violet about 40°' and 'white light' labels (28-30 px) and the 26 px footer are as weak as the mono note

rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)
fixed: the hook writes 'How does a rainbow form?' first (96 px, two lines of 100 px in the vertical), done by about 0.5 s (0.6 s in the vertical) and underlined by 0.7 s; sun, viewer, cloud, rain and bow follow under it (the brief's title reordered into a question, as allowed)

in the vertical the arm swings toward the right edge (15°) while the pen is in the upper part and ramps smoothly to the brief's 25° tilt lower down, so the sleeve lies beside the captions, never across the drop or the recap icons (a deliberate departure from 'always from the bottom right' in the vertical)

the timeline is rebudgeted on the beat grid (0 / 100 / 240 / 360 / 480 / 660 / 860): the fixed caption waits are gone, captions follow their drawings, 'about 42°' holds 2.7 s, 'Red outside, violet inside.' holds 2.2 s before the eraser starts, and the end holds 1.5 s after the hand leaves
the eraser accelerates into its landing instead of easing to a stop; each landing (frames 120, 680, 880) has a hit, a 3% camera kick and a puff of eraser dust
the mono note and footer are 30 px, 'white light' 32-34 px, 'violet about 40°' 34-36 px

the vertical big-picture bow ran off the right edge (bow right at 1210 px on a 1080 frame; missed in round 1): the scene is scaled 0.82 about the ground so the bow ends at 992 px, both sight lines still meet their bands (red 115 px, violet 296 px from the eye), and 'point opposite the sun' sits in two lines beside the arrow instead of on the dashed line
the final hold kept moving with a steady push-in, so still-frames stays empty

problems.what: the wipe landing is audible but barely visible: the hand drops the eraser and flies to the next drawing on the landing frame, so the dust puffs in an empty corner, and the grey ghost of the old board keeps fading slowly, so nothing on screen lands with the hit
problems.fix: hold the eraser on its landing for 3 frames with a small recoil and the dust around it, and snap the ghost to a fainter level on the landing beat

problems.what: while the exit rays are drawn at the bottom of the drop, the arm crosses the 'colour spread exaggerated' note for about a second
problems.fix: none needed: transient, and the note is not being read at that moment

agentMissed: the vertical big-picture bow ran off the right edge of the frame (found in round 2; present since the build)
retiming exposed an overlap: the 42° arc would still be drawing while 'about 42°' was written (caught from the schedule before rendering and fixed)

rounds.reviewer: claude-opus-5-5 (critique agent, separate from the builder)
fixed: the eraser holds on its landing for 3 frames with a recoil, the dust puff sits around it (clamped inside the frame), and the old board's ghost snaps from 35% to 13% on the landing beat, so the board visibly comes clean with the hit; the big-picture preamble is 4 frames tighter so the bow still completes on its beat (780) and the marker is still capped on the sign-off beat (960)

problems.what: tools/critique.mjs reads 0 changes per 10 s and one 34 s calm: its change test needs a mean frame difference over 18 grey levels, which fine line art on a warm-white board never reaches without a flash the style forbids
problems.fix: none: variety is scored from the sheet, where something new is drawn every 1-2 s and the three wipes land on beats with a hit, dust and a board that snaps clean

problems.what: the big picture mixes a side view (sun, eye, sight lines) with a front-view bow centred on the ground; it is a schematic, and the angles on it are the true 40° and 42°
problems.fix: none needed; the footer says 'angles approximate'
